head_commit.message:
capital structure V2 F0: financial-input availability binding

Bind each funding item (unrestricted/restricted cash, marketable securities,
receivables, revolver availability, accrued interest, debt maturities,
minimum-liquidity covenant, committed expenditures, financing costs) to its
owner, availability class and cash-basis membership, without rebuilding FIF.
Record context items that never substitute (net loss is never burn; undated
debt balances are never maturities), refuse collapsed FIF headlines, and
state the burn and flow rules F1 enforces (A28/A29/A30). The financials
schema is pending the seat's C0 delta #9266.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(prophet): news-impact w1c rulings - exact audit reserve, fail-closed agreement gate, design amendments (#9262)

DEC:NEWS-IMPACT-W1C-DESIGN-RULINGS settles the seven defects found at W3
integration: three code repairs and four design amendments.

- cascade: audit reserve target = ceil(Fraction(str(rate)) * capacity), so
  0.14 * 50 is 7, not 8; clamps unchanged.
- agreement: a critical field with n_compared == 0 makes the template
  unusable (not_evaluable); a null kappa at n_both_present >= 20 fails as
  kappa_undefined_single_category. pause_labeling is unchanged.
- AMENDMENTS_W1C.md amends C5, X4 4.7(h), M2, E3, T1 and P7 without editing
  the frozen A-design packets; AMENDMENTS_W1C.cases.json carries the
  superseded A4 matched-window values for the X4 follow-up.

The X4 session-counted matched window lands in a follow-up PR.

Co-authored-by: Sol CEO <actions@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Grey Deer W7: PBOC liquidity state, T12 sample builder with T19 B2 masks, research drafts (#9208)

* engine: typed PBOC liquidity state from an open-market window

A pure classifier keeps an announced zero-operation day apart from a day
that was not observed, and calls a quiet stretch ample only when the
money-market spread agrees. Display and context only; nothing is wired.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* Draft the T13 mechanism preregistration, outcome-blind.

Census of macro, rates, credit, funding, dollar and vol-term
producers. Two vintaged series are estimable. The rest stay
ineligible until a publication clock and a first-published
vintage exist. No outcomes computed.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* research(grey-deer): draft the 14-ticker forward panel addendum

Describe how prereg v1.1's panel would be issued and graded by the SPY
forward writer without changing a frozen rule.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* fix(grey-deer): finite-guard the PBOC liquidity read and wire its tests into CI

A NaN amount compared False against every bound and landed in net_drain; amounts and the
MLF/FR007/policy-rate inputs now must be finite. The tests run in their own exclusive
grey-deer-pboc-liquidity job (CURATED_EXCLUSIVE) so no packing probe moves.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Draft T14 preregistration for leader-damage pullback tests.

Outcome-blind draft only. Eligible features are traded ETF ratios. Constituent-rebuilt breadth, live baskets, and surprise panels are marked ineligible.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* Draft the T19 costed-protection preregistration.

Outcome-blind research display for issued pullback warnings.
Parameters, clocks, lag, costs, metrics, baselines, bootstrap,
multiplicity budget, and kill criteria are fixed in the draft.
This draft grants no live capital authority.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* census: where a portfolio envelope shadow adapter would attach

Read-only GD-9A seam census of Mastermind origin/master 98d00027 against the macro risk envelope. Records book writers, the existing envelope consumer, shadow receipt homes, and three attach points. No adapter code.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* Add a seeded Grey Deer episode and negative-control sample builder.

One close series becomes frozen-rule event episodes and matched control
windows, so later mechanism studies can freeze the same sample before
looking at outcomes. Stage-1 clustering is imported, not reimplemented.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* ci(grey-deer): run the T12 episode-sample builder tests in the stage-1 job

Adds scripts/research/grey_deer_episode_samples.py and its test file to the grey-deer-pullback-stage1
exclusive job's paths and pytest step. The builder imports only the stage-1 module, which the job already
covers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(grey-deer): T19 draft says I26 exists but lacks matched_protection_masks

The T12 sample builder is now on this branch, so the draft's 'absent on this base' wording was
stale. B2 still reads BLOCKED_BUILDER_ABSENT because the function it imports is not in the module yet;
lane GD-W7-T12MASK builds it against the section 10 contract. Draft only; nothing is frozen.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add matched-protection masks for the T19 B2 baseline.

matched_protection_masks keeps the policy's protected-session count and
run lengths, placed at random so each run stays whole and runs never touch.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* docs(grey-deer): T19 draft names the B2 builder that now exists

matched_protection_masks is exported by the T12 sample builder, so the
draft's I26 row, the B2 section and the assumption list no longer say it
is absent. The conditional BLOCKED_BUILDER_ABSENT rule stays as written.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
